description: Accessible form field: binds its control (native or form-associated custom element), times validation, shows hint/error outputs and wires aria-describedby / aria-invalid

attributes.name: data-valid
attributes.description: Valid state. Set by the component when a valid field has a value (not for empty optional fields); can be set by hand.

attributes.name: data-invalid
attributes.description: Invalid state: reveals output.error and the error icon. Set by validate()/setError(); survives moving the field.

attributes.name: data-type
attributes.description: Inline label + control layout for checkable controls. No validation icon.

attributes.name: data-no-icon
attributes.description: Disable the validation status icons.

attributes.name: data-floating-label
attributes.description: Animated floating label (floating-label-init). A real placeholder keeps the label floated. Adds data-floating-label-ready when enhanced.

attributes.name: data-pending
attributes.description: Dims the field and blocks pointer input while something is in flight.

attributes.name: data-state
attributes.description: Async validation hook: warning border and spinner in the icon slot.

attributes.name: data-message-invalid
attributes.description: Last-resort error message when no data-message-*, authored error text or control message applies.

attributes.name: data-label-show-password
attributes.description: Accessible name of the password toggle while the password is hidden.

attributes.name: data-label-hide-password
attributes.description: Accessible name of the password toggle while the password is shown.

attributes.name: data-label-digit
attributes.description: OTP/PIN box name; {n} and {total} are replaced.

attributes.name: data-label-incomplete
attributes.description: OTP/PIN partial-code message (used when the input has no data-message-patternmismatch); {total} is replaced.

attributes.name: data-label-strength
attributes.description: Accessible name of the password strength meter.

attributes.name: data-label-strength-weak
attributes.description: Strength level text.

attributes.name: data-label-strength-fair
attributes.description: Strength level text.

attributes.name: data-label-strength-good
attributes.description: Strength level text.

attributes.name: data-label-strength-strong
attributes.description: Strength level text.

attributes.name: data-label-requirements
attributes.description: Accessible name of the password rules checklist.

attributes.name: data-label-rule-length
attributes.description: Length rule text; {n} is replaced.

attributes.name: data-label-rule-uppercase
attributes.description: Uppercase rule text.

attributes.name: data-label-rule-lowercase
attributes.description: Lowercase rule text.

attributes.name: data-label-rule-number
attributes.description: Number rule text.

attributes.name: data-label-rule-special
attributes.description: Special-character rule text.

attributes.name: data-label-strength-empty
attributes.description: Meter value text (aria-valuetext) when the password is empty.

attributes.name: data-label-strength-too-weak
attributes.description: Validity message when the password is below data-strength-min.
attributes.default: Choose a stronger password. Meet more of the requirements.

attributes.name: data-label-rule-met
attributes.description: Visually hidden state text appended to a met rule.

attributes.name: data-label-rule-unmet
attributes.description: Visually hidden state text appended to an unmet rule.

attributes.name: data-floating-label-ready
attributes.description: Set by floating-label-init once the floating label is wired. Do not set by hand.

attributes.name: data-otp-ready
attributes.description: Set once the OTP/PIN boxes are built (hides the status icon). Do not set by hand.

childAttributes.name: data-message-valuemissing
childAttributes.description: Message for valueMissing. Every ValidityState key has one: data-message-badinput, -typemismatch, -patternmismatch, -tooshort, -toolong, -rangeunderflow, -rangeoverflow, -stepmismatch, -customerror. On a custom element (or the field) for custom controls.

childAttributes.name: data-message-badinput
childAttributes.description: Message when the browser can't parse the entry (e.g. letters in type=number).

childAttributes.name: data-message-customerror
childAttributes.description: Message for a custom validity error; without it the custom message itself is shown.

childAttributes.name: data-type
childAttributes.description: Multi-box OTP/PIN entry. The input stays a visually hidden, validatable text input (required + a \d{length} pattern).

childAttributes.name: data-rules
childAttributes.description: Comma-separated strength rules: length:N, uppercase, lowercase, number, special. Unicode-aware; unknown rules are skipped with a warning.

childAttributes.name: data-strength-min
childAttributes.description: Minimum strength level; weaker non-empty passwords get a custom validity error. Advisory when absent.

childAttributes.name: data-count
childAttributes.description: Character ("") or word ("words") counter, added to aria-describedby; announced only near the limit.

childAttributes.name: class
childAttributes.description: hint: help text, collapses when valid; error: hidden (visibility: hidden) until invalid, authored text is the fallback message.

structure.description: Field label (for= the control id). The required asterisk goes on it when it is the field's only label.
The bound control. Radios bind their whole name group.
Error message; in aria-describedby only while invalid.

events.name: form-field:upgraded
events.description: Bubbles once the field has bound its control.

properties.name: fieldName
properties.description: Human-readable field name (label or legend text, else aria-label, name or id) for error summaries. Read-only.

properties.name: input
properties.description: The bound control: the first form-associated custom element in the field (date-picker, star-rating, combo-box …), else the first native input/textarea/select. Read-only.

methods.name: validate({ show = true } = {})
methods.description: Validate the bound control and show the result immediately (error text, data-invalid/data-valid, aria-invalid, aria-describedby) — no blur needed; the form coordinator calls it on submit. Returns the validity. { show: false } returns validity without touching the UI.

methods.name: setError(message)
methods.description: Show a programmatic (e.g. server) error. Also set as the native control's custom validity so the form won't submit; cleared on the user's next edit. Never clears a custom error set by other code.

methods.name: clearError()
methods.description: Clear the field's own programmatic error and return to the neutral state.
